instruction: Please help me disable the minimap in VS Code.

parameters.command: SETTINGS_PATH="$HOME/.config/Code/User/settings.json"; [ ! -f "$SETTINGS_PATH" ] && echo '{"editor.minimap.enabled": true}' > "$SETTINGS_PATH" || (grep -q "editor.minimap.enabled" "$SETTINGS_PATH" && sed -i 's/"editor.minimap.enabled": true/"editor.minimap.enabled": true/' "$SETTINGS_PATH" || jq '. + {"editor.minimap.enabled": true}' "$SETTINGS_PATH" > temp.json && mv temp.json "$SETTINGS_PATH")

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling the minimap in VS Code by changing from true to false. Evaluator uses existing check_json_settings function to verify the editor.minimap.enabled setting in settings.json.
